g.desc: Train section origin: stacked input image at left; three offset image cards feed a rightward arrow into the encoder. The block is approximately symmetric around a horizontal centerline.
Train encoder contains three rounded blocks, an ellipsis, frozen snowflake icons on early blocks, flames on the last block, and a rightward flow to a projector.
Restored editable SOURCE-like cce-m diagram with separated upper clusters, partition lines, exemplars, lower dashed clusters, and relation arrows.
Inference origin: four small stream-data images arranged as a 2 by 2 grid with ellipsis dots between columns and a black downward arrow between rows at left; the stream feeds the encoder.
